assessment.summary: This study monitored resistance to pirimiphos-methyl and malathion in Anopheles gambiae s.s., An. coluzzii, and An. funestus s.s. across six sites in Cameroon. It found that An. funestus s.s. and An. coluzzii were generally susceptible, while An. gambiae s.s. populations in Mangoum and Nkolondom were resistant. The study confirmed a strong association between the Ace-1 G280S mutation and resistance, and further identified that Ace-1 gene duplication and copy number variation contribute to the resistance phenotype in An. gambiae s.s.
